name: Event Calendar with Date Selection and Management
summary: Calendar-based event manager CodeComponent using Calendar with custom DayButton for event dot indicators. Selected date shows event list with Popover for detail view and delete action. Add event Dialog with title Input, time Select, and category Select. Badge for event categories (Meeting=blue, Deadline=red, Social=green, Task=yellow). Date formatting with date-fns format(). useAppState for selected date, useArrayState with append/remove for events, toast on add/delete. 12 demo events spread across the current month. No backend required.
shortSummary: Calendar event manager with date selection, event list, add/delete dialogs, and category badges
